name: Regular Council Meeting
agenda_text:
City of El Segundo Video Streaming
MEETING SUMMARY
Call to Order
a. Proclamation announcing week of September 20 th through 26 th as Volunteer Recognition Week.
b. Proclamation announcing observance of the 33 rd Annual Richmond Street Fair on Saturday, September 26, 2009
Public Communications
B. Special Orders of Business
1. Continued Public Hearing regarding the Fiscal Year 2009-2010 Budget.
25. Amend the City Manager's FY 09/10 Budget recommendation for City financial assistance to El Segundo Unified School District.
Consent
11. Two Resolutions providing for salary increases and benefit changes to Chapter 1A2 of the El Segundo Administrative Code.
12. Approval of a three-year MOU between the City of El Segundo and California Teamsters Public, Professional and Medical Employees Union, Local 911, Supervisory and Professional Employees' Bargaining Unit.
24. Adoption of Ordinance No. 1433 adding a new Chapter 10-5 to the El Segundo Municipal Code ("ESMC") regulating water conservation methods and amending ESMC §§ 1-2A-1, 1-2A-2, and 1-2A-3 to enforce Chapter 10-5.
Council Comments
25. Action to direct staff to prepare an amendment to the General Plan and process the re-zoning of the property located at 1916 E. Imperial Highway .
Public Communication
